ev.q: the player builds a base, defends it, and acquires weapons through tech trees
There are various weapons like missiles, lasers, cannons, miniguns, and mortars to attack with
Teams are able to choose one of 15 commanders from 5 different factions
The match can be set to team death match where each player gets their own fort and resources
team co-op where all players on the team shares resources and bases
Sandbox allows the player to experiment in any map without AIs or other players
